correctness.rationale: Complete analytic proof: (d+1) disjoint homothetic caps, each volume t^d and exact radial second moment J0[t²+(d+2)(1−t)²], give full-dimensional covariance and normalized isotropic formula. The derivative has a positive prefactor times S_d(t). Explicit factorization for d=2,3,4 and P_d(1/2)=(5−d)/4≤0 for d≥5 prove strict signs and exceptional minimizer. All endpoint normalizations and asymptotic are shown; 12 rational hull-integration configurations checked independently.

value.rationale: The barycentric corner truncation is a canonical affine-invariant continuum from any simplex to its rectification; the theorem gives its complete affine-normalized covariance-scale profile and sharp optimizer for all d≥2. A qualitatively different planar reversal at the regular hexagon, as opposed to high-dimensional monotonicity, and an exact exponentially small endpoint gain are substantive geometric phenomena, not a single arithmetic recomputation.
